gloss: timed type; time-delayed; set to a timer

definitions.gloss: timed type; time-delayed; set to go off at a preset time
definitions.explanation: Describes a device or mechanism set to activate at a predetermined time or after a set interval. Most familiar in {時限式|じげんしき}{爆弾|ばくだん} (time bomb), but also used of locks and switches.

examples.japanese: {時限式|じげんしき}の{爆弾|ばくだん}が{見|み}つかった。
この{金庫|きんこ}は{時限式|じげんしき}のロックがついている。
examples.english: This safe has a time-delay lock.

examples.japanese: {照明|しょうめい}を{時限式|じげんしき}にして、{決|き}まった{時間|じかん}に{自動|じどう}で{消|き}えるようにした。
examples.english: I made the lighting timer-controlled so it turns off automatically at a set time.

notes:
Formed from {時限|じげん} (time limit, set period) + {式|しき} (type, style, system). Used attributively, usually as {時限式|じげんしき}の + noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時限式|じげんしき}{爆弾|ばくだん}: time bomb
- {時限式|じげんしき}ロック: time-delay lock
- {時限式|じげんしき}の{装置|そうち}: a timed device

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自動|じどう}: automatic — acts on its own, but not necessarily at a preset time
- タイマー: timer — the device itself; {時限式|じげんしき} describes the manner of operation
